summary: Iteration 46: DDT signatures (destinatario/conducente/vettore) in-app + temporary public signing link + PDF embedding. Backend: new pytest suite tests/test_iteration46_ddt_firme.py (12 tests) + regression t44 + t45 = 53/53 passed. Frontend (Playwright): DDT editor firme card for confirmed DDT (hidden for bozza), signature dialog (save disabled until drawing + name>=2, clear re-disables), save shows image/name/date/user, vettore default name prefilled, remove button only for admin (hidden for operatore), link generation shows origin/firma-ddt/{token} + copy button + expiry; public page at tablet viewport without login shows company/DDT/client/lines (no prices), signing shows 'Firmato da', bad token shows error. PDF shows images + name + Europe/Rome time in all 3 boxes. All test data cleaned.

minor.issue: No status check (can remove signatures on annullato DDT), returns ok:true even if role was not signed, and removal is not audited (no trace of who deleted a collected signature).
Returns firma_link object (sha256 hash, created_by email) to the client; not exploitable but unnecessary - consider projecting out firma_link.hash.

ui_bugs.issue: On POST failure (e.g. link expired/role already signed by someone else) the error goes into firma-public-esito which is behind the still-open dialog overlay; user sees no feedback until closing the dialog. Show the error inside the dialog or close it.
Canvas backing size computed only on mount; tablet orientation change/resize while the dialog is open will misalign strokes with the pointer.

issues: 'Inizio trasporto' uses native datetime-local picker (mm/dd/yyyy placeholder) instead of shadcn date picker

action_items: (Low) Show public signing errors inside FirmaDialog (or close dialog) so the user sees them
(Low) Recompute SignaturePad canvas size on resize/orientationchange
critical_code_review_comments: salva_firma atomic update filters on firme.{ruolo}: null (good, race-safe for duplicates) but not on status; a concurrent annulla could still accept a signature - negligible.
reportlab dedupes identical image bytes in the PDF (only matters for tests using the same PNG for all roles).
Public link token is 256-bit, stored as sha256, replaced on regeneration, 404 on expired/annullato - correct. Public GET exposes no prices/images/hash (verified).
